// grid does not converge on one plan, strategies mix, and the reactive
// rules (free stop, weather, spent set) fire in the right order. ~0.1 s.

// an exact <track>|<tod> key still overrides. VM-executed atmosphere.js, ~0.1 s.

// centreline. One unresolvable pair discards a circuit's whole table and

package.json's test scripts and tools/ci/tooling-fast.mjs's file list are
GENERATED from this file by tools/gen/gen-test-groups.mjs; edit here, then
run that generator. `--check` is on the fast gate, so drift fails at once.
Adding a group used to mean three coordinated edits (package.json, the
tooling-fast list, docs/TESTING.md); it is one edit here now.

In `toolingFast`, an entry beginning `//` is a comment line emitted verbatim into the generated block — the notes explaining why a given file earns a place in the edit loop live here, not in the generated file.
limits: Static filesystem and textual consumer inspection only; no tests, generator execution, browser, network, staging, or commit.
Existence/glob expansion does not prove test behavior, browser discovery or runtime success.
Per-group semantic contracts derive from generator/runner; individual test implementations were not audited.
Historical commentary is evidence of claims, not current timing or gate guarantees.
